title: Grapple with Gertie
description: Grapple with Gertie — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Grapplin' Gertie

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Find the gym in MutantMania's level 3. Once inside, introduce yourself to Grapplin' Gertie.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Grapplin' Gertie

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Pumping Irony

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find the gym in MutantMania's level 3. Once inside, introduce yourself to Grapplin' Gertie.

Offer:

Ah've been hearing good things about Grapplin' Gertie. She's a new competitor who is racing up the ranks in the MutantMania. Ah'm adding her to the payroll to help you train. You mentor her and she'll be your protege. Trainee, that is.

Friend, go meet the little lady and spar with her for a bit. You'll find her in the Level 3 gym, but you'll also have to pass through a bit of a rough neighborhood to get there. Report back to me after you spar with him. Her. Ah said her.

Turn-in:

Hi! *Smile!* You must be my new mentor. I'm Grapplin' Gertie! *Giggle!*

Client level range: 82–100
